name: Student outcome story
hint: Lead with a concrete outcome: faster results for students, per-question feedback a teacher couldn't produce by hand.

name: Free exam-analysis workshop
hint: Offer to run Yomnita on ONE recent exam's answer sheets free and present the insights to their academic team.

name: Industry insight
hint: A teacher-workload / correction-burden data point relevant to their board and exam calendar.

name: Event or webinar invite
hint: Invite to a principals' roundtable / live demo webinar with peer schools.

name: Case study
hint: A comparable school's experience with Yomnita (pilot results, teacher quotes).

name: Time-sensitive pilot cohort
hint: Limited seats in this term's free pilot cohort; aligned to their next exam cycle.

name: Peer social proof
hint: What principals of similar schools in their city/region are exploring; fear of falling behind peers.
